concept.reason: Direct reference imagery and taxon-specific sources sufficient for original silhouette; no extra concept image.

scope: Original Cheirolepis trailli living reconstruction, guided by Fukui museum fossil photograph and JNCC published reconstructions after Pearson and Westoll1979. Not a specimen scan.

scientific_limits.en: Body thickness, fin margins, gape pose, color and dimensions are estimates. The actual Fukui photograph is small and flattened; JNCC panels A/B are restorations, not fossils. JNCC's captioned T00382/A photograph is missing in this PDF and was not observed.
scientific_limits.zh: 体厚、鳍缘、张口姿态、颜色及尺寸均为估值。福井实物照片较小且化石受压扁；JNCC的A/B图是复原图而非化石照片。该PDF缺失图注所述T00382/A照片，并未观察到它。

taxon_scope: Cheirolepis trailli; historical Cheirolepis uragus treated as synonym in JNCC

dimensions_estimate_m.basis: Artistic envelope near illustrated small fish proportions, not measured specimen.

shape_requirements: Original small scaled ray-finned body with large gape and uneven tail lobes. Large mouth must read without turning head into armored placoderm block.
Long oblique jaw line and moderate open mouth, tapered scaled trunk, tail with upward extended axial lobe and unequal web lobes.
Paired pectoral/pelvic fins and posterior dorsal/anal fins; low-poly fin-ray cues subordinate to silhouette.
Subtle small scale rhythm on trunk, not Coccosteus head shield or large gar-like plate armor.
construction_notes: Keep exact scale count and fin-ray count simplified and explicitly artistic.
Use geometry for visible tail asymmetry and mouth opening; no texture-only substitute.
Restrained gray brown palette, static swimming pose; no water scene required.

shape_gate.en: Shape criterion: small scaled ray-finned body with large gape and uneven tail lobes. Retain this anatomical combination when compared with nearby forms; a name, scale or pose change alone does not qualify.
shape_gate.zh: 形态判据：小型鳞质辐鳍鱼身体、大口与不等尾叶。须与相近形态对照保留这一结构组合；仅改名称、尺寸或姿态不成立。

modeling_brief.en: Original low-poly brief: block small scaled ray-finned body with large gape and uneven tail lobes with a small number of readable masses; preserve negative spaces and joint transitions. Use a restrained neutral palette; simplify surface texture only after the silhouette reads. Validate the diagnostic feature before detailed geometry.
modeling_brief.zh: 原创低多边形说明：用少量清晰体块组织小型鳞质辐鳍鱼身体、大口与不等尾叶；保留负空间与关节过渡。采用克制的中性色；轮廓成立后再简化表面纹理。精细几何制作前须核实鉴别特征。

material_profile: palette-only static original geometry; restrained natural palette; no reference images embedded
gray_model_gate: Three low-cost front/side/oblique checks before detailing; original inventory shape combination must read. No extra views except a specific unresolved problem.
final_evidence: Four exact-export front/side/top/perspective views; perspective may equal preview. Existing technical/export/viewer gates, two isolated rebuilds and fresh independent QA remain required.
